audit_items.proof_trace: ObligationOwnerCap has `key, store` but no `copy` or `drop`; the Move bytecode verifier statically prevents any duplication. All struct fields are module-private and the sole constructor `obligation::new()` is `public(package)`, so external contracts cannot forge the cap. Sui's object ownership model additionally enforces that only the cap's current owner can include it as a transaction input, making all three sub-properties (is_unique, cannot_be_copied, cannot_be_forged) provably true at both the language and runtime levels.
